bill.summary:
Making the CFPB Accountable to Small Businesses Act of 2025
This bill requires the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) to consider the impact of proposed rules on small entities.
In addition, the CFPB, the Environmental Protection Agency, and the Occupational Safety and Health Administration must justify decisions to not adopt certain alternatives to regulations that are applicable to small entities.
